diagnostics.title: JSON parse/stringify deep clone
diagnostics.message: `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))` deep-clones by re-serializing: it is slow on large objects and silently drops `undefined`, functions, `Date`/`Map`/`Set`, and cyclic references. Use `structuredClone(x)`.
diagnostics.help: Replace `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value))` with `structuredClone(value)`. It is faster and preserves Dates, Maps, Sets, and cyclic references.

diagnostics.title: Enter submit without IME composition guard
diagnostics.message: This text-entry Enter handler commits/submits without bailing on IME composition, so it fires mid-composition for CJK users pressing Enter to confirm a candidate. Bail first with `if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;` (or track `onCompositionStart`/`onCompositionEnd`) before acting on Enter.
diagnostics.help: Bail on IME composition before acting on Enter: `if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;` (or track composition with `onCompositionStart`/`onCompositionEnd`). Otherwise Enter fires mid-composition and commits a half-typed value for CJK users.

diagnostics.title: Synchronous XMLHttpRequest
diagnostics.message: A synchronous `XMLHttpRequest` (`.open(method, url, false)`) freezes the main thread until the request finishes, blocking all rendering and input. Use `fetch()` or an async XHR (`open(method, url, true)`).
diagnostics.help: Never open an XMLHttpRequest synchronously (`async` = `false`). It blocks the main thread. Use `fetch()` or pass `true` and handle the response asynchronously.

diagnostics.title: fetch Response consumed without status check
diagnostics.message: `fetch()` resolves (does not reject) on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so this unchecked body read may treat an HTTP error payload like a successful response. Check `response.ok`/`response.status`, or deliberately handle the API's error payload, before reading the body.
diagnostics.help: Check `response.ok` (or `response.status`) before consuming a `fetch` Response with `.json()`/`.text()`/`.blob()`. `fetch` resolves on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so an unchecked response parses the error body as success or crashes on an always-truthy guard.

diagnostics.title: Unversioned localStorage key
diagnostics.message: localStorage.setItem("video-muted", JSON.stringify(...)) has no version, so changing the data shape later crashes your users' saved sessions. Add one to the key (e.g. "video-muted:v1").
diagnostics.help: Put a version in the storage key (e.g. "myKey:v1"). If you change the data shape later, old saved data can be ignored instead of crashing the app.

diagnostics.title: Loading flag reset outside finally

diagnostics.help: Switch to the Zod 4 versions: top-level factories like `z.enum()`, object helpers like `z.strictObject()`, the new `z.function({ input, output })` form, and explicit key/value schemas for `z.record()`.

diagnostics.title: JSON parse/stringify deep clone
diagnostics.message: `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))` deep-clones by re-serializing: it is slow on large objects and silently drops `undefined`, functions, `Date`/`Map`/`Set`, and cyclic references. Use `structuredClone(x)`.
diagnostics.help: Replace `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value))` with `structuredClone(value)`. It is faster and preserves Dates, Maps, Sets, and cyclic references.

diagnostics.title: Enter submit without IME composition guard
diagnostics.message: This text-entry Enter handler commits/submits without bailing on IME composition, so it fires mid-composition for CJK users pressing Enter to confirm a candidate. Bail first with `if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;` (or track `onCompositionStart`/`onCompositionEnd`) before acting on Enter.
diagnostics.help: Bail on IME composition before acting on Enter: `if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;` (or track composition with `onCompositionStart`/`onCompositionEnd`). Otherwise Enter fires mid-composition and commits a half-typed value for CJK users.

diagnostics.title: Media missing captions
diagnostics.message: Deaf and hard-of-hearing users need captions for this media. Add a `<track kind="captions">` inside the `<audio>` or `<video>`.
diagnostics.help: Add `<track kind="captions">` inside every `<audio>` / `<video>`.

diagnostics.title: postMessage handler without origin check
diagnostics.message: A message event handler reads cross-window messages without an obvious origin check.
diagnostics.help: Validate `event.origin` against an exact allowlist before using `event.data`, especially when an iframe or parent window can be attacker-controlled.

diagnostics.title: Synchronous XMLHttpRequest
diagnostics.message: A synchronous `XMLHttpRequest` (`.open(method, url, false)`) freezes the main thread until the request finishes, blocking all rendering and input. Use `fetch()` or an async XHR (`open(method, url, true)`).
diagnostics.help: Never open an XMLHttpRequest synchronously (`async` = `false`). It blocks the main thread. Use `fetch()` or pass `true` and handle the response asynchronously.

diagnostics.title: fetch Response consumed without status check
diagnostics.message: `fetch()` resolves (does not reject) on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so this unchecked body read may treat an HTTP error payload like a successful response. Check `response.ok`/`response.status`, or deliberately handle the API's error payload, before reading the body.
diagnostics.help: Check `response.ok` (or `response.status`) before consuming a `fetch` Response with `.json()`/`.text()`/`.blob()`. `fetch` resolves on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so an unchecked response parses the error body as success or crashes on an always-truthy guard.

diagnostics.title: Unversioned localStorage key
diagnostics.message: localStorage.setItem("video-muted", JSON.stringify(...)) has no version, so changing the data shape later crashes your users' saved sessions. Add one to the key (e.g. "video-muted:v1").
diagnostics.help: Put a version in the storage key (e.g. "myKey:v1"). If you change the data shape later, old saved data can be ignored instead of crashing the app.
